## ClassMate 1.1.44 Release Notes

- Universal Batch Overrides: Support institutional email or student ID for re-admitted / dropout students across all universities
- Automatic Onboarding Placement: Re-admitted students are instantly placed in their designated batch upon first sign-in
- Multi-University Data & Notification Isolation: Guaranteed batch-scoped notifications with zero cross-university notification leaks
- Restored global app update push notification dispatch to all active verified devices
- Full parity between Android app and Web companion for batch override management
